description: Authorizes pull request approval after validating repository authorization, required reviews, successful status checks, branch protection, and risk assessment.

unboundSignalReasons.repositoryAuthorized: Result of an independent repository-authorization check; the Intent's target (owner/repo#pullNumber) identifies the PR, not whether the repository is authorized.
unboundSignalReasons.requiredReviewsCompleted: Attested by GitHub's own review state; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.statusChecksPassed: Attested by GitHub's own CI/status-check state; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.
unboundSignalReasons.branchProtected: A property of the target branch's GitHub configuration, independently verified; not a field the Intent declares.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed change-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Pull request authorized. Repository authorization, review requirements, status checks, branch protection, and risk assessment requirements were satisfied.
Pull request rejected because the assessed risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Pull request rejected because one or more required status checks did not complete successfully.
Pull request rejected because the target branch is not protected.
Pull request rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
